title: LayerRoute: Input-Conditioned Adaptive Layer Skipping via LoRA Fine-Tuning for Agentic Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.01838v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic language model systems alternate between two structurally distinct step types: structured tool calls (short, deterministic, low perplexity) and open-ended planning/reasoning steps (long, complex, high perplexity). Despite this heterogeneity, current inference systems apply identical compute to every step. We introduce LayerRoute, a lightweight adapter that learns to selectively skip transformer blocks on a per-input basis. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with: (1) a per-layer router (~897 parameters, Linear(896,1)) that outputs a hard binary gate via the straight-through estimator, and (2) LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters) on the Q/K/V/O attention projections. The backbone weights remain frozen. A single end-to-end training pass on agentic data (Hermes, Glaive, GSM8K, Turing) with a gate regularisation term forces the system to discover which blocks are skippable pe

translated_title: LayerRoute：基于LoRA微调的面向智能体语言模型的输入条件自适应层跳过方法
translated_abstract: 智能体语言模型系统在两种结构截然不同的步骤类型之间交替：结构化工具调用（简短、确定性、低困惑度）和开放式规划/推理步骤（冗长、复杂、高困惑度）。尽管存在这种异质性，当前的推理系统却对每个步骤都施加相同的计算量。我们提出了LayerRoute，这是一种轻量级适配器，能够学会针对每个输入选择性地跳过transformer块。LayerRoute为Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct中的24个transformer块分别增强了：(1) 逐层路由器（约897个参数，Linear(896,1)），通过直通估计器输出硬二进制门控信号；(2) 位于Q/K/V/O注意力投影上的LoRA适配器（秩为8，约108万个参数）。骨干网络权重保持冻结。通过在智能体数据（Hermes、Glaive、GSM8K、Turing）上进行单次端到端训练，并辅以门控正则化项，迫使系统发现哪些块是可以跳过的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: LayerRoute通过为Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct的每个transformer层配备轻量级二进制门控路由器和LoRA适配器，学习根据输入特征动态跳过不必要的层，使智能体语言模型在结构化工具调用和开放式推理这两类异构步骤间实现自适应计算分配。
